items.title: Help defend against memory poisoning in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with multi-layer write validation
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory helps AI agents maintain context across sessions through persistent short-term and long-term memory. Because memory content is automatically retrieved and injected into future conversations, the integrity of what gets written to memory directly shapes future agent behavior, which makes the write path a valuable control point to strengthen.
